products.name: Microsoft Intune First-Time Setup for Windows — Essentials (Self-Deploy)
products.short_description: Self-Deploy. The complete, click-by-click documentation to get your first Windows PCs into Intune two ways — user-driven enrollment and basic Entra-joined Autopilot. Do it yourself, on your schedule.
products.description:
Your first Windows devices in Intune — two ways, done right

Intune is switched on, but no Windows PCs are actually managed yet. This is the beginner on-ramp that closes that gap: a single, ordered playbook that gets your first Windows devices enrolled two complementary ways — user-driven enrollment (a user joins their PC to Microsoft Entra ID and it auto-enrolls) and basic Windows Autopilot (a new or reset device provisions itself, zero-touch, during out-of-box setup). Both land the device Microsoft Entra joined, Intune-enrolled, managed, and reporting compliant.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The Essentials variant is the full solution as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a novice admin can follow end to end.

  • Simpler — exact navigation in the right order, with every object you create named (INTBASE - Windows Users - Pilot, INTBASE - Autopilot Devices, INTBASE - Autopilot - Pilot, INTBASE - ESP - Pilot) and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open consulting meter (comparable engagements run $1,500–$3,000 per day).
  • Proven — a pilot-first path (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit PASS/FAIL enrollment gates, so you know both devices landed managed and compliant.

What you'll accomplish

  • Turn on automatic Windows enrollment and scope it to a named pilot group.
  • Enroll an existing PC the user-driven way (Entra join → auto-enroll).
  • Register a device, build a basic Entra-joined Autopilot deployment profile and Enrollment Status Page, and provision one zero-touch device.
  • Get the enrollment-time grouping right (the Autopilot device group is Assigned and owned by the Intune Provisioning Client) — the single detail that makes or breaks a first Autopilot run.
  • Validate both devices against clear pass/fail criteria.

Where the boundary is — and where to go next

This is Windows only and Microsoft Entra ID–joined only, by design. Hybrid Entra join, advanced or multi-profile Autopilot, deep Enrollment Status Page tuning, dynamic-group strategy, co-management, and app packaging are out of scope here — they belong to the deeper Windows Autopilot and Cloud-First Autopilot Zero-Touch solutions, which build directly on this foundation. Not sure Intune is even enabled yet? Start with the free Enable Microsoft Intune Quick-Start.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk. Buy once, keep the playbook, and reuse it for every wave of devices.

The bottom line

In one focused session you go from “Intune is on but nothing is managed” to your first Windows devices enrolled two ways, validated and compliant — and a clear path to scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

The Essentials variant is documentation only — the complete guide, yours to keep and reuse across unlimited devices:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: executive summary, solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, and best practices.
  • Implementation Guide (Word) — the same guide in editable Word format.

Delivered as a single Essentials package: this guide as a PDF and a Word document. Want the automation and a done-for-you deployment? Choose the Plus (We-Deploy) variant.

products.description:
We stand up your first Windows enrollments — with you, not just for you

Same proven first-time setup as Essentials, but instead of handing you the manual and walking away, the Plus (We-Deploy) variant gives you the automation to do it fast and a done-for-you deployment service so it is actually finished, validated, and compliant.

Includes a done-for-you deployment

After checkout, we reach out within one business day to schedule and run your basic Intune stand-up and first Windows enrollments — user-driven and basic Entra-joined Autopilot — alongside your team. We enable automatic Windows enrollment, create the named pilot objects, set the critical enrollment-time grouping (the Autopilot device group owned by the Intune Provisioning Client), register and provision a zero-touch device, and validate both enrollment paths against clear pass/fail gates. You keep every artifact and the know-how to expand.

Everything you get

  • The complete guide (PDF + Word) — the same click-by-click documentation as Essentials.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts (read-only by default, cloud-aware for Commercial & US Gov):
    • INTBASE-Preflight.ps1 — verify licensing, roles, MDM authority, auto-enrollment scope, and that the Intune Provisioning Client owns the Autopilot group.
    • INTBASE-Get-AutopilotHash.ps1 — collect a device's Autopilot hardware hash for import.
    • INTBASE-Validate-Enrollment.ps1 — confirm a device is Entra-joined, enrolled, and compliant.
    • INTBASE-Report-Enrollment.ps1 — list enrolled Windows devices by enrollment method.
    • INTBASE-Remediation.ps1 — guarded (-WhatIf default) fix for a missing group owner or auto-enrollment scope.
  • 4 configuration templates — sample Autopilot deployment profile, Enrollment Status Page, Windows enrollment restriction, and a hardware-hash CSV template.
  • The deployment service — we run the basic stand-up and first enrollments with you after purchase.

Why Plus

  • Faster — the scripts and templates remove the fiddly parts (hash capture, ownership checks, validation evidence).
  • De-risked — a specialist runs the first enrollments with you and confirms both paths land managed and compliant, so there is no “did I get the Autopilot group ownership right?” guesswork.
  • Yours forever — keep the docs, scripts, and templates to expand to the rest of the fleet.

Scope — and what's next

Windows only, Microsoft Entra ID–joined only. Hybrid Entra join, advanced/multi-profile Autopilot, deep ESP tuning, dynamic-group strategy, co-management, and app packaging are out of scope here and belong to the deeper Windows Autopilot and Cloud-First Autopilot Zero-Touch solutions.

The bottom line

You get the automation, the templates, and a specialist who runs your first Windows enrollments with you — the fastest, lowest-risk way to go from “Intune is on” to a validated, compliant first fleet.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices, plus a deployment service fulfilled after purchase:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF + Word) — the complete, click-by-click solution.
  • PowerShell Scripts — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview).
  • Configuration Templates — 4 sample JSON/CSV config files (Autopilot profile, ESP, enrollment restriction, hardware-hash CSV).
  • We-Deploy service — after checkout we contact you within one business day to schedule and run your basic Intune stand-up and first Windows enrollments.

Delivered as a single Complete Solution Package (guide as PDF + Word, all five PowerShell scripts, and the configuration templates), plus the post-purchase deployment service. Prefer to do it entirely yourself? Choose the Essentials (Self-Deploy) variant.
